title: DbDataBuild mapped model
description: A mapped model: the declaration of a table that exists and that the tool does not build (models/<schema>/<table>.yml with `kind: {type: mapped}` and no .sql). Models refer to it by plain table name, and `dbdatabuild define` builds an empty DuckDB schema from it. `indexes` and `foreign_keys` are what the table has, as exported by `dbdatabuild import`; the tool reads them (metadata, advice) and never creates them. In an editor this applies to a file that says `kind: {type: mapped}` itself (model.schema.json hands such files to this schema); a file that gets its kind from a folder's _dbdatabuild.yml is read as a model definition.

^(connections|kind)[=+-]$.description: A suffix on a setting that inherits from the project files above: `key=` replaces what was inherited, `key-` removes the listed items, `key+` merges (the default).

name.description: Schema-qualified table name. Must equal the path under models/ with '/' replaced by '.' (models/staging/orders.yml is staging.orders).

kind.description: Always `{type: mapped}`: a mapped model builds nothing.

connections.description: The connections the table exists on. Without it, the project's default connections. A list adds to what the project files above the model give; write `connections=` to replace it.

grain.description: Columns that uniquely identify a row. Optional; used to propose grain candidates for models built on this table.

type.description: A SQL type written as a plain string, for example `BIGINT` or `DECIMAL(14, 2)`.

indexes.description: The indexes the table has, as exported by `import-sources`. The tool reads them and never creates them; the index that backs the primary key is the grain, not listed here.

foreign_keys.description: The foreign keys of the table, as exported by `import-sources`.
